description: Move a character's IK targets — drag a hand or a foot somewhere and let Studio solve the limb, instead of rotating every joint by hand. Values are absolute offsets from the target's rest position, in scene units, so repeating a call is idempotent; read the current ones from studio_list_bones. Scene scale is not metric (a character is roughly 15 units tall), so derive distances from the transforms you read rather than assuming metres. Pass several targets in one call: the moves become a single undo step. Requires mode 'ik' (studio_set_character_kinematics) and the target's IK group to be on. Only the four hand and foot targets accept 'rot'; the shoulder, thigh and '_chain' pole targets are position-only.

targets.description: one entry per IK target, keyed by the target name from studio_list_bones

pos.description: absolute offset from the target's rest position, in scene units

rot.description: absolute euler angles in degrees; only accepted on left_hand, right_hand, left_foot and right_foot ('rotatable': true in studio_list_bones)

output.description: same shape as studio_list_bones, restricted to the targets this call touched ('bones' is empty)
